text: Of David. A psalm. I will sing of your love and justice; to you, O Lord, I will sing praise.
when will you come to me? I will walk in my house with blameless heart.
no vile thing. The deeds of faithless men I hate; they will not cling to me.
I will have nothing to do with evil.
him will I put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, him will I not endure.
that they may dwell with me; he whose walk is blameless will minister to me.
will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.
all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the Lord.
